basic_info.description: This spacious 2 story one-bedroom, 1.5 bath condo loft offers a well-designed layout and great features. The bedroom provides ample space for a desk and sitting area and is flooded with light from a large window.  It has an en-suite bath and walk-in closet with custom built in cabinetry. The main floor has an open concept living area that seamlessly integrates the living/dining space and kitchen, creating a versatile and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen is equipped with Fisher & Paykel and Bosch appliances and has loads of counterspace including bar seating, facilitating meal preparation and entertaining. There is also tons of storage including a walk-in pantry. Also on this level is a half-bath, laundry and 3 additional closets, allowing for added functionality. Throughout the home, abundant natural light enhances the sense of openness and warmth. The home is wired for Sonic gigabit fiber internet as well as comcast/xfinity and AT&T.  It is located near great shops and services like Gus's Grocery, Safeway as well as terrific restaurants and coffee shops.  Located in the warmer and flatter part of SF and with numerous  transportation options, this home is convenient to so many of the great amenities that the City has to offer. There is parking for one car and deeded storage.
